headings.style: Kinetic, bold, tight tracking, text reveal animations
headings.scale: text-4xl to text-6xl+ for Hero. Never exceed 6xl.

body.style: Geometric, highly readable, light font weight, low contrast against background

labels.style: Uppercase, tracking-[0.2em], used for data labels, technical specs, chapter numbers

gold_accent.usage: Exclusively for Primary CTAs (WhatsApp Evaluation) and rare accents

visual_enhancers.hero: Cinetic typography with line-by-line reveal (masked). Subtle parallax effect with neon vial background.
visual_enhancers.marquee: Slow editorial marquee with technical terms, low contrast pale background/dark text or kinetic outline text.
visual_enhancers.panels: Glass-morphism cards for content with LED-edge lighting (1px blue/white border on top/left).
visual_enhancers.infographics: Vector-style scientific data viz using mono-spaced labels, representing GLP-1, GIP, Glucagon triple agonism.

components.hero: Framer Motion line-by-line reveal, Lenis parallax.
components.cta: Golden button with glowing effect, pulse animation, and WhatsApp icon.

grids_and_layouts.strategy: Bento grid protocol, asymmetrical layouts for marketing feel. Dense data clusters for scientific stats.
grids_and_layouts.spacing: Generous spacing. p-8 to p-12 for containers, huge gaps for sections (py-24).

motion.reveal: Framer Motion for scroll reveals, text masking, line-by-line rendering.
motion.micro: Hover states with subtle translations (-translate-y-1) and glow enhancements.

accessibility.contrast: APCA/WCAG AA compliant. High contrast on text, focus states clearly defined with neon blue rings.

images.description: Neon blue molecule structural line art, useful as a fallback for the 3D vial.
Abstract quantum physics equations, great for the clinical studies background or infographic sections.
Medical consultation context image for the WhatsApp evaluation section.

3d_libraries.recommendation: Use framer-motion and simple CSS 3D transforms for parallax. For floating particles, TSParticles is recommended for subtle data point visual effects.

instructions_to_main_agent: Follow the Dark underground neon aesthetic strictly: background #030308, neon blue (#00A3FF) accents, and gold (#D4AF37) strictly for the WhatsApp CTA.
Implement 10 pages: Home + 9 satellite pages (O que é, Como funciona, Estudos clínicos, vs Mounjaro, Efeitos colaterais, Status regulatório ANVISA, Dosagem, Consultoria, FAQ) using React Router.
Build a kinetic hero section with line-by-line text reveal using framer-motion. Implement subtle parallax scrolling on the hero background.
Create a slow editorial marquee using Framer Motion or react-fast-marquee.
Use glass-morphism panels for scientific content cards, featuring semantic backlinks to the satellite pages.
Develop custom vector infographics to explain the GLP-1/GIP/Glucagon triple agonist mechanism.
Ensure all interactive elements have 'data-testid' attributes.
Write code in .js (not .tsx) as the environment is standard JS.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Do not use generic centered layouts. Use asymmetrical, high-tension grids.
Create depth with layered glassmorphism and subtle LED edge lighting (1px borders).
Never use pure transparent backgrounds for overlays; always use a blur + tint (e.g., bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-xl).
Do not use a universal 'transition: all'. Apply specific transitions.
Implement micro-animations on all hover states.
Use 'sonner' for any required toast notifications.
